items.text: Person A constantly pursues new goals and feels alive through striving. Person B has achieved enough and finds joy in simple daily pleasures. Who has the better approach?

options.A: Person A—striving is the essence of a meaningful life
options.B: Person A probably, though B's contentment has merit
options.C: Neither is better—depends on the individual
options.D: Person B probably, though A's drive has merit

items.text: Someone feels guilty for being content and not "hustling." They should:

options.A: Push themselves—complacency is the enemy of growth
options.B: Consider whether more ambition might serve them
options.C: Examine where the guilt comes from
options.D: Recognize contentment as a valid choice
options.E: Embrace their contentment—it's a gift, not a flaw
